metadata.description:
Travel around the globe from the comfort of home with Myths of the World.  

This captivating audio collection brings together legendary folklore from six incredible cultures: China, Greece, the Norse lands, Egypt, the Celtic Isles, and Japan. Listeners will meet brave heroes, fearsome monsters, clever tricksters, and powerful gods, all while discovering the rich heritage and storytelling traditions of ancient civilisations.  

Whether listening during quiet play, long journeys, or winding down before bed, these thrilling tales are sure to ignite young imaginations and foster a lifelong love for global history and mythology.
